runtime_profile_summary: Python 3.11 virtualenv with acryl-datahub (editable), snowflake-connector-python, pytest
notes: Environment requires pre-generated metadata module from PyPI package. OpenJDK 21 JRE installed for Gradle support (JDK 17 not available in Debian Trixie; Gradle works fine with JDK 21). Fixed package names for Debian Trixie: python3-venv (generic, not python3.11-venv). git and curl are pre-installed in python:3.11-slim base image. Additional dependencies: msal for OAuth support.
